actor: a woman with a dark ponytail in a grey hoodie
before: in frame 1 the briefcase is on the floor beside the woman, who gestures toward the red-sweater person
after: in frame 3 the woman holds the briefcase in her hands in front of her

consequence: she ends up carrying the burden or task (the briefcase) herself, apparently uncomfortable about it, possibly after the other person pushed it onto her or she failed to refuse; unclear
